evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 800 EUR
This is a secondary school-leaving certificate equivalent to the German "Abitur" that entitles you to study at a German university.

notes: Tuition: THI's central pages state a general figure of 800 EUR per semester for Bachelor students from third countries from summer term 2026 (https://www.thi.de/en/studies/financial-assistance/, https://www.thi.de/en/studies/international-degree-students/tuition-fees/), but the DAAD page for this programme states 'non-EU countries 800 EUR' which may be per semester; period taken as semester. The application period 2 May - 15 July is given for 'applicants from: all countries' and no year is stated on the DAAD page, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline; the THI programme page states 'Application period for the winter semester 2027/28: 2 May to 15 July 2027' but that quote only appears on the English programme page provided. Grade thresholds and selection procedures are not stated on the supplied pages.

note.fr: Vérifiez si vous devez fournir une preuve d'anglais : la page indique un niveau B2 requis/recommandé, sans preuve exigée.
note.en: Check whether you need to provide English proof: the page states B2 required/recommended, no proof required.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required/recommended, no proof required
